armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is **Asuryani**, at the start of the battle round, you receive a number of Battle Focus tokens based on the battle size, as shown below:
▪ **Incursion:** 2 Battle Focus tokens.
▪ **Strike Force:** 4 Battle Focus tokens.
▪ **Onslaught:** 6 Battle Focus tokens.

Each time one of the triggers shown in the Agile Manoeuvres section below occurs, you can spend one Battle Focus token to enable the relevant eligible unit to perform that Agile Manoeuvre. A unit is eligible to perform an Agile Manoeuvre if it has this ability and has not already performed an Agile Manoeuvre in the same phase. Unless otherwise stated, you cannot trigger the same Agile Manoeuvre more than once per phase. At the end of the battle round, all unspent Battle Focus tokens are lost.

### Swift as the Wind
**TRIGGER:** When an eligible unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move. You can trigger this Agile Manoeuvre more than once per phase (provided a different unit performs it each time).
**EFFECT:** Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

### Flitting Shadows
**TRIGGER:** When an eligible unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.
**EFFECT:** Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at that unit.

### Star Engines
**TRIGGER:** When an eligible VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to make an Advance move.
**EFFECT:** Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

### Sudden Strike
**TRIGGER:** When an eligible unit from your army ends a charge move.
**EFFECT:** Until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

### Opportunity Seized
**TRIGGER:** When an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
**EFFECT:** One eligible unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

### Fade Back
**TRIGGER:** In your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
**EFFECT:** One eligible unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that was hit by one or more of those attacks can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

**Disparate Paths:** When mustering your army, you can include Harlequins units in your army, even though they do not have the **Asuryani** Faction keyword. Unless otherwise stated, you cannot select Harlequins or Ynnari as your Army Faction.
armyRule.flavor: In war, as in all things, the Aeldari bring the full might of their intellect, skill and agility to bear upon the task. Coupled with their exceptional technology, this ensures they move with swiftness and grace that is impossible for the foe to match.
armyRule.name: Battle Focus

enhancements.body: ASURYANI model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, remove it from play, then, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.
enhancements.flavor: Aeldari myth tells how Isha once drew down the heat of a hundred stars into a glittering gem to save Asuryan. The Phoenix Gem is the only surviving fragment of this ancient stone and retains the power to return life to the fallen.
enhancements.name: Phoenix Gem

enhancements.body: ASURYANI model only. At the start of the battle round, if the bearer is on the battlefield (or any TRANSPORT it is embarked within is on the battlefield), you receive 1 additional Battle Focus token.
enhancements.flavor: This ancient Aeldari war leader has commanded armies for the entire lifetimes of the younger mortal species. Their mastery of the swift, decisive and reactive strategy is second to none.
enhancements.name: Timeless Strategist

enhancements.body: ASURYANI model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Command Re-roll Stratagem for 0CP.
enhancements.flavor: It is far easier to avoid fatal battlefield errors if one has already foreseen when they will occur and how to prevent them.
enhancements.name: Gift of Foresight

enhancements.body: ASURYANI PSYKER model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.
enhancements.flavor: This psyker has refined the destructive potential of their mental abilities, honing them to a fine and frighteningly lethal point.
enhancements.name: Psychic Destroyer

rule.body:
▪ At the start of the battle round, you receive 1 additional Battle Focus token.
▪ Each time a unit from your army performs the Swift as the Wind Agile Manoeuvre, until the end of the phase, add an additional 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.
▪ Each time a unit from your army performs an Agile Manoeuvre that involves rolling a D6, add 1 to the result.
rule.flavor: Every element of a Warhost operates with speed and efficiency, units swirling around one another in an agile storm of blades and tightly controlled ferocity. The Aeldari know precisely where they must be at any given stage of the battle plan and move with inhuman elegance that leaves their enemies reeling in their wake.
rule.name: Martial Grace

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: Processing events at incredible speed, these warriors easily evade attacks that would have slain any less celeritous combatants.
stratagems.name: Lightning-Fast Reactions
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 12". If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.flavor: When unleashed in a close-ranged storm, Aeldari weapons fire can completely eradicate all life within the target zone.
stratagems.name: Blitzing Firepower
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: If your ASURYANI unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.
stratagems.flavor: The Aeldari excel in striking swiftly, then leaping back into the safety of their skimming transports.
stratagems.name: Skyborne Sanctuary
stratagems.target: One unengaged ASURYANI unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".
stratagems.flavor: The Aeldari are masters of hit-and-run tactics, engaging a target with a flurry of shots before swiftly ducking back out of harm’s way.
stratagems.name: Fire and Fade
stratagems.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT.
stratagems.target: That ASURYANI unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT, ASURMEN and WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) has shot.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.flavor: What appears to be a full retreat one moment is revealed as the deceptive prelude to a devastating attack the next.
stratagems.name: Feigned Retreat
stratagems.target: That ASURYANI unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ASURYANI unit from your army Falls Back.

stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.flavor: By slipping away into the ethereal confines of the Webway, Aeldari warriors can circumnavigate the foe and strike from new and unexpected quarters.
stratagems.name: Webway Tunnel
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

enhancements.body: ASURYANI MOUNTED model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 9" ability.
enhancements.flavor: Those who lead the Windrider Hosts do so from the front, embodying the first of the Swords of Vaul drawn in wrath.
enhancements.name: Firstdrawn Blade

enhancements.body: ASURYANI MOUNTED model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
enhancements.flavor: This field generator surrounds its bearer with contradictory sensor ghosts and split-second illusions that make them incredibly challenging to target, particularly when moving at speed.
enhancements.name: Mirage Field

enhancements.body: ASURYANI MOUNTED PSYKER model only. Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer have the [ANTI-MONSTER 2+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 2+] abilities.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior has mastered the art of augmenting their mounted attack runs with lashing blades of focused psychic power that punch through the heaviest armour and monstrous hide to vital targets deep within.
enhancements.name: Seersight Strike

enhancements.body: ASURYANI MOUNTED model only. In your Command phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is not within your deployment zone, and adding an additional 1 to the result if the bearer is within your opponent's deployment zone: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.
enhancements.flavor: Riding out to battle upon their skimming steed, this charismatic commander is reminiscent of the great Aeldari hero come again. The mere sight of them swooping down upon their foes inspires their warriors to remarkable feats of heroism in their turn.
enhancements.name: Echoes of Ulthanesh

rule.body:
In the Declare Battle Formations step you can set up **Asuryani Mounted** and **Vyper** units from your army in Reserves. During the battle, such units can be set up on the battlefield as if they were arriving from Strategic Reserves. For the purposes of setting up **Asuryani Mounted** or **Vyper** units from your army on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

In addition, at the end of your opponent's turn, you can select a number of **Asuryani Mounted** or **Vyper** units from your army (excluding units within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units), then remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size:
▪ **Incursion:** 1 unit.
▪ **Strike Force:** 2 units.
▪ **Onslaught:** 3 units.
rule.flavor: These hosts strike from many quarters, employing their incredible speed and agility to evade and ambush the foe at every turn.
rule.name: Ride the Wind

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Streaking suddenly down from on high, the Aeldari strike like the fall of an executioner’s blade.
stratagems.name: Death from on High
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or Vyper unit from your army that was set up on the battlefield from Reserves this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 7".
stratagems.flavor: These airborne warriors arc up and away from the ruin of their foes, already seeking fresh prey.
stratagems.name: Overflight
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
stratagems.when: End of your Shooting phase or the end of the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
stratagems.flavor: Warriors such as these cannot be pinned down or held back. They hit and run at will, hammering the foe with constant fire and slashing blows.
stratagems.name: Wind of Blades
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or Vyper unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield from Reserves, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. When doing so, if your unit is set up within 8" horizontally of one or more enemy units, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.flavor: Some of the Windrider Hosts are especially aggressive, unable to restrain the fierce joy of racing perilously close to the foe while strafing them with fire.
stratagems.name: Daring Riders
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or Vyper unit from your army in Reserves.
stratagems.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.flavor: Able to analyse and assess target data at incredible speeds, these Aeldari isolate the foe’s weak spot and pour all their fire into it as they hurtle past.
stratagems.name: Focused Firepower
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or Vyper unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.flavor: None but the Aeldari could risk such breakneck and seemingly suicidal evasive manoeuvres to jink around incoming enemy fire.
stratagems.name: Spiralling Evasion
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or Vyper unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

enhancements.body: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of INFANTRY models in that unit and add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic of MONSTER models in that unit.
enhancements.flavor: The mind of this Spiritseer shines with psychic illumination, burning away the veils that cloud the senses of the dead.
enhancements.name: Light of Clarity

enhancements.body: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer (excluding TITANIC units). Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.
enhancements.flavor: Wound about with finely inscribed myths of Kurnous, the Hunter, this wraithbone staff imbues ghost warriors with an echo of the slain god’s keen-eyed skill.
enhancements.name: Stave of Kurnous

enhancements.body: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, unless the attacking model is within 18", models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
enhancements.flavor: This rare psychic rune binds occluding psychic energies about nearby wraith constructs to baffle the foe’s senses.
enhancements.name: Rune of Mists

enhancements.body: Spiritseer model only. In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
enhancements.flavor: Knowing their crucial role in guiding the ghost warriors, this seer chooses duty over personal glory.
enhancements.name: Higher Duty

rule.body:
Each time an **Asuryani Psyker** model from your army is destroyed by an enemy unit, that enemy unit gains a Vengeful Dead token. Each time a **Wraith Construct** model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit with one or more Vengeful Dead tokens, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Asuryani Psyker models from your army have the following ability:
▪ **Spirit Guides (Aura):** While a Wraithblades, Wraithguard or Wraithlord unit from your army is within 12" of this model, that unit has the Battle Focus ability.
rule.flavor: When guided by a Spirit Conclave, the ghost warriors gain a clarity and prowess they would otherwise lack. Moreover, should the foe slay any of their precious spirit guides, the dead will surely have their vengeance.
rule.name: Shepherds of the Dead

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your PSYKER model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your Wraith Construct unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Armour Penetration and/or Damage characteristics of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: Seeing their prey as much through the eyes of their guiding seer as with any sense of their own, the wraith constructs strike swift and true.
stratagems.name: Seer's Eye
stratagems.target: One AELDARI PSYKER model from your army and one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of it that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: The apparent fragility of wraith constructs’ lithe bodies belies their incredible resilience.
stratagems.name: Wraithbone Armour
stratagems.target: One Wraith Construct unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
stratagems.flavor: Sometimes, the twinned perceptions of ghost warriors allow them to perceive — and strike at — the souls of their foes.
stratagems.name: Blades from Beyond
stratagems.target: One Wraithblades, Wraithlord or Wraithknight unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your Wraithblades, Wraithguard or Wraithlord unit is considered to be within 12" of your PSYKER model for the purposes of the Psychic Guidance and Spirit Guides abilities.
stratagems.flavor: It is risky for a Spiritseer to cast their awareness so far, but aiding the dead is sometimes necessary.
stratagems.name: Soul Bridge
stratagems.target: One Wraithblades, Wraithguard or Wraithlord unit from your army and one ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.flavor: By leaving psycho-resonant wraithbone markers upon the battlefield, these warriors wreathe vital strategic locations in an aura of dread not easily overcome.
stratagems.name: Spirit Token
stratagems.target: One Wraithblades or Wraithguard unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each Wraithblades model in your unit, or roll four D6 if your unit has the Wraithlord keyword, or roll six D6 if your unit has the Wraithknight keyword: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.flavor: Elegant they may be, but the weight and implacable strength of wraith constructs on the charge can smash enemies to the ground bloody and broken.
stratagems.name: Crushing Strides
stratagems.target: That Wraithblades, Wraithlord or Wraithknight unit.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Wraithblades, Wraithlord or Wraithknight unit from your army ends a Charge move.

enhancements.body: ASURYANI model only. The bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5.
enhancements.flavor: Appointed as the mastermind behind the defence of an entire craftworld, this warrior will hold vital ground at all costs.
enhancements.name: Craftworld's Champion

enhancements.body: ASURYANI model only. In the Deploy Armies step, select up to two Guardians units from your army. Models in the selected units have the Infiltrators ability.
enhancements.flavor: Knowing secret paths through the Webway, the bearer can direct warriors to outmanoeuvre the foe.
enhancements.name: Ethereal Pathway

enhancements.body: ASURYANI model only. While the bearer is leading a Dire Avengers or Guardians unit, once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP, and while resolving that Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+, or unmodified Hit rolls of 4+ instead if the bearer's unit is within range of an objective marker you control.
enhancements.flavor: This warrior’s knowledge of the home ground on which they fight allows them to expertly position their forces to bracket the routes of the enemy’s approach with fire.
enhancements.name: Protector of the Paths

enhancements.body: ASURYANI model only. While the bearer is leading a Storm Guardians unit, each time you roll to determine the number of attacks made with a flamer equipped by a model in that unit, you can re-roll the result, and each time you make a Damage roll for a model equipped with a fusion gun in that unit, you can re-roll the result.
enhancements.flavor: An ancient relic of Aeldari technology, this device enhances the lethality of those weapons said to channel the killing heat of Vaul’s blazing forges.
enhancements.name: Breath of Vaul

rule.body: Each time a **Dire Avenger**, **Guardian**, **Support Weapon** or **War Walker** model from your army makes an attack, if that model's unit and/or the target unit are within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Hit roll.
rule.flavor: Battlehosts often deploy to protect arterial Webway gates, the world shrines of vulnerable Exodite worlds or the domes and galleries of their home craftworld; this lends their warriors an especially keen determination to protect their holdings from foes.
rule.name: Defend at All Costs

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Woe betide the foe that seeks to claim the holdings of armed and determined Asuryani.
stratagems.name: Warding Salvoes
stratagems.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: If your unit is within range of one or more objective markers, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Exploiting a spar of old Aeldari technology, these warriors engage the flickering ghosts of ancient defensive force fields.
stratagems.name: Shield Nodes
stratagems.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: After that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
stratagems.flavor: Swift and terrible vengeance comes for those who dare strike down the warriors of the Aeldari in the form of searing heavy weapons fire.
stratagems.name: Vaul's Vengeance
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
stratagems.target: One WAR WALKERS unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.flavor: Storm Guardians train to recognise where and when their selfless aggression can best benefit their craftworld and never to miss such opportunities.
stratagems.name: Time to Strike
stratagems.target: One Storm Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.
stratagems.flavor: Asuryani martial teachings enable those wielding ranged weapons to employ them as close-quarter implements of death as well.
stratagems.name: Blades of Asuryan
stratagems.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. When doing so, return every destroyed Guardians model to your unit.
stratagems.flavor: In so desperate and vital a fight, the Aeldari must accept casualties they would normally avoid and even send fresh warriors in to bolster the flagging ranks if it means victory.
stratagems.name: Cost of Victory
stratagems.target: One Guardians unit from your army.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

enhancements.body: Troupe Master model only. Each time the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit, then roll one D6 for each model in the bearer's unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
enhancements.flavor: This vicious monofilament lariat unspools from its wielder’s gauntlet in a heartbeat, lashing through the foe before retracting as they tumble into bloody chunks.
enhancements.name: Cegorach's Coil

enhancements.body: HARLEQUINS model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
enhancements.flavor: So terrifying and yet so captivating are the shifting aspects of this Harlequin’s psychoreactive mask that they can hypnotise foes or stop their hearts with fear.
enhancements.name: Mask of Secrets

enhancements.body: Death Jester model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, each successful Hit roll scores a Critical Hit.
enhancements.flavor: This malevolent shrieker cannon catalyses its victims’ fear impulses into exaggerated bioelectric shocks, forcing them to scare themselves to death.
enhancements.name: Murder's Jest

enhancements.body: Shadowseer model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators ability.
enhancements.flavor: Employing their psychic powers of illusion and obfuscation, this Shadowseer can cause their comrades to vanish from the foe’s perceptions.
enhancements.name: Mistweave

rule.body: Each time a **Harlequins** model from your army makes a Charge move, it can move through enemy models.
rule.flavor: Trying to fight the Harlequins of the Laughing God is like battling bladed smoke. They flip and bound through the enemy ranks with contemptuous ease, springing across the heads and shoulders of dumbfounded combatants, sprinting across the hulls of war engines, all the while bearing down with murderous intent upon their true intended victims.
rule.name: Acrobatic Onslaught

stratagems.effect: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
stratagems.flavor: A feigned death and sudden, shocking return are as impactful as dismaying to the foe.
stratagems.name: Staged Death
stratagems.restrictions: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.
stratagems.sublabel: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Any phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.flavor: Though they may be slain, this step of the saedath calls on the players to act out the demise of tragic heroes who take their enemies with them to death.
stratagems.name: Heroes' Fall
stratagems.sublabel: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.flavor: The Harlequins tumble away in mock terror and panic before spinning back into the fight with cruel laughter and redoubled fury.
stratagems.name: Mocking Flight
stratagems.sublabel: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HARLEQUINS unit from your army Falls Back.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: To the Harlequins, the foe are simply unwitting dance partners, their every move matched with graceful aplomb.
stratagems.name: Tricksters' Retort
stratagems.sublabel: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One Troupe unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
stratagems.flavor: Enemies goaded into following the steps of the saedath come unwittingly on cue to their executions.
stratagems.name: Bloody Dance
stratagems.restrictions: Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
stratagems.sublabel: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.flavor: Players know when to fade back from the stage of war, ready to strike again when their moment comes.
stratagems.name: Exit the Stage
stratagems.sublabel: Ghosts of the Webway – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

enhancements.body: Farseer model only. The bearer's Eldritch Storm weapon has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
enhancements.flavor: This psychic executioner projects the extinguishing will of the Aeldari death god into the minds of the foe, reducing them to ashen grey husks in moments.
enhancements.name: Gaze of Ynnead

enhancements.body: Warlock model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.
enhancements.flavor: As though this Warlock were a conduit to the realm of the unquiet dead, they are surrounded by an endless susurrus that chills the foe with terror.
enhancements.name: Storm of Whispers

enhancements.body: Archon model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.
enhancements.flavor: This cruel warrior steals a portion of animus from each vanquished foe, keeping a little of Ynnead’s due to empower themselves and slay more foes in his name.
enhancements.name: Borrowed Vigour

enhancements.body: Succubus model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
enhancements.flavor: Driven to new heights of cold fury and icy strength by the death energies flowing through their sinews, this arena champion fights with supernatural vigour.
enhancements.name: Morbid Might

rule.body:
You can use the following rules:

### Lethal Intent
At the end of your opponent's Shooting phase, if one or more **Ynnari** units from your army were destroyed this phase, select one **Ynnari Infantry** or **Ynnari Mounted** unit from your army that was within 6" of your destroyed unit. That unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D6+1".

### Lethal Surge
Once per turn, when a **Ynnari** unit from your army performs the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre, it can make a surge move of up to D6+1" instead of a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]**.

### Lethal Reprisal
At the start of the Fight phase, select one **Ynnari** unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that is below its Starting Strength. Until the end of the phase, that unit has the Fights First ability.

**Servants of the Whispering God:**
▪ You can include **Ynnari** units in your army, even though they do not have the **Asuryani** Faction keyword.
▪ **Asuryani** units (excluding **Epic Heroes**) from your army gain the **Ynnari** keyword.
▪ You must include Yvraine and/or The Yncarne in your army, and one of those models must be your **[gloss:warlord:Warlord]**.
rule.flavor: Surrounded by the slaughter on the battlefield, the Ynnari channel the sinister supernatural gifts of Ynnead to great effect.
rule.name: Strength from Death

stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.flavor: Even after they fall, the most fervent Ynnari leave a sinister sense of watchfulness in their wake like some invisible death shroud.
stratagems.name: Pall of Dread
stratagems.sublabel: Devoted of Ynnead – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Any phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Such is the conviction and power of the Ynnari that sometimes even mortal wounds cannot slow them.
stratagems.name: Macabre Resilience
stratagems.sublabel: Devoted of Ynnead – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One YNNARI INFANTRY or YNNARI MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If your unit is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
stratagems.flavor: Immersed in murder and gripped by holy purpose, these warriors bring Ynnead’s fatal message and his final gift to all who face them.
stratagems.name: Emissaries of Ynnead
stratagems.sublabel: Devoted of Ynnead – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: That YNNARI INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a YNNARI INFANTRY unit from your army has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.flavor: In the moment of transcendent glory, before the Ynnari give their essence to their god, they fight harder than ever to take the foe with them to death.
stratagems.name: Parting the Veil
stratagems.sublabel: Devoted of Ynnead – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
stratagems.flavor: Perceiving the flickering soulstuff of their foes, the Ynnari strike with ruthless precision.
stratagems.name: Soulsight
stratagems.sublabel: Devoted of Ynnead – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase.
stratagems.flavor: As the foe slays their warriors, a terrible vigour grips the Ynnari and compels them to repay the slaughter in kind.
stratagems.name: Death Answers Death
stratagems.sublabel: Devoted of Ynnead – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.target: One YNNARI unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units), if one or more models in that unit were destroyed this phase.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Shooting phase.

enhancements.body: ASURYANI PSYKER model only. In your Command phase, you can add 1 to or subtract 1 from the value of one Fate dice in your Fate dice pool.
enhancements.flavor: This helm houses a psychocrystalline weave that aids the wearer in sifting clarity and truth from the myriad ghosts of unrealised futures.
enhancements.name: Lucid Eye

enhancements.body: ASURYANI PSYKER model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds, Psychic Attacks and Critical Wounds caused by attacks with the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
enhancements.flavor: These precisely crafted runic wards hold harmful empyric energies and predatory entities at bay, protecting the bearer’s mind and soul.
enhancements.name: Runes of Warding

enhancements.body: ASURYANI PSYKER model only. Add 12" to the Range characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.
enhancements.flavor: This ancient gem was recovered from the crone world of Lleghaine and is said to resonate with the rage of that dead world’s ghosts. It acts as a magnifying lens for destructive psychic powers.
enhancements.name: Stone of Eldritch Fury

enhancements.body: ASURYANI PSYKER model only. Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of the bearer with a Stratagem, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, increase the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.
enhancements.flavor: Waves of malevolent energies roll from this article of warrior jewellery. Though they leave Aeldari systems and minds untouched, they cloud the enemy’s thoughts with doubt, lace their communications with mournful wails and scatter confusing sensor ghosts across their instruments.
enhancements.name: Torc of Morai-Heg

rule.body:
At the start of the first battle round, you generate Fate dice by rolling a number of D6 based on the battle size, as shown below. Keep your Fate dice to one side — this is your Fate dice pool.
▪ **Incursion:** 3 D6.
▪ **Strike Force:** 6 D6.
▪ **Onslaught:** 9 D6.

Each time you use one of the Stratagems opposite, if your Fate dice pool contains one or more Fate dice showing the corresponding value in the table below, you can discard one of those corresponding Fate dice. If you do, reduce the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP:
▪ **Presentiment of Dread** — Fate dice value **1**.
▪ **Forewarned** — Fate dice value **2**.
▪ **Unshrouded Truth** — Fate dice value **3**.
▪ **Fate Inescapable** — Fate dice value **4**.
▪ **Isha's Fury** — Fate dice value **5**.
▪ **Psychic Shield** — Fate dice value **6**.
rule.flavor: Though future sight is not a precise art, the Aeldari seers excel in its craft. Having read the strands of fate that twine and branch through the upcoming battle, they direct events down their favoured paths at the most opportune moments.
rule.name: Strands of Fate

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to your model. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
stratagems.flavor: The seer plucks fate to find the foe suffering a horrible death, then projects it into their minds.
stratagems.name: Presentiment of Dread
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army.
stratagems.when: Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: Having foreseen already how this fight will play out, the seer projects their insights and warnings into the minds of the Aeldari who must fight it.
stratagems.name: Forewarned
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect:
▪ Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**.
▪ Your unit has [core:Deep Strike].
▪ Your unit must make an **[gloss:ingress-move:ingress move]** this phase (including in your first turn).
stratagems.flavor: Dispelling the psychosomatic mirage that has so far beguiled and assailed the foe, the seer reveals the true location of the warriors it was masquerading as.
stratagems.name: Unshrouded Truth
stratagems.restrictions: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to be selected to move.
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that has not been selected to move this phase, was not set up on the battlefield this phase, and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.flavor: The Aeldari have already seen how best to lay low this enemy and strike in the sure knowledge the foe cannot evade their terrible fate.
stratagems.name: Fate Inescapable
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.flavor: Leaping from the seer’s outstretched hand, this blast of empyric energy is a raw expression of the sorrow and bitterness suffered by the Aeldari people.
stratagems.name: Isha's Fury
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army within 9" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
stratagems.flavor: A twist of the seer’s psychic powers raises a whirling shield of empyric energy and psychokinetic debris to screen the Aeldari from enemy fire.
stratagems.name: Psychic Shield
stratagems.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

enhancements.body: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer, and those weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.
enhancements.flavor: Khaine is a murderous deity, and many of his aspects channel this element of his nature to some degree. Combining these teachings renders this warrior a truly fearsome assassin.
enhancements.name: Aspect of Murder

enhancements.body: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, each time that unit is selected to shoot or fight, until the end of the phase, models in that unit gain both of the abilities from the Path of the Warrior Detachment rule.
enhancements.flavor: This ritual relic marks the bearer out as one who has walked the Path of Command for ages untold and whose understanding of all things martial borders on the preternatural.
enhancements.name: Mantle of Wisdom

enhancements.body: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
enhancements.flavor: This simple and elegant gem conceals complex technology based on Dire Avenger shimmershields, its protective aegis extending across the bearer and those who fight at their side.
enhancements.name: Shimmerstone

enhancements.body: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.
enhancements.flavor: A commander who knows with absolute certainty which strategic goals must be achieved, this warrior can appraise the battlefield at a glance.
enhancements.name: Strategic Savant

rule.body:
Each time an **Aspect Warriors** or **Avatar of Khaine** unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, select one of the following abilities for it to gain until the end of the phase:
▪ Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
▪ Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
rule.flavor: The teachings of Khaine’s martial aspects are diverse and highly specialised, each completely lethal in its own nuanced fashion.
rule.name: Path of the Warrior

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill, Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
stratagems.flavor: So absolute is the focus of these warriors in battle that nothing can distract them or stay their blows.
stratagems.name: Warrior Focus
stratagems.target: One Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.flavor: As champions and defenders of a dying race, these warriors fight furiously to the very end.
stratagems.name: To Their Final Breath
stratagems.target: One Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: If your ASURYANI unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.
stratagems.flavor: The Aeldari excel in striking swiftly then leaping back into the safety of their skimming transports.
stratagems.name: Skyborne Sanctuary
stratagems.target: One unengaged ASURYANI unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model's Wailing Doom ranged weapon has a Range characteristic of 18" and a Damage characteristic of 8.
stratagems.flavor: Cast with the force of a thunderbolt, the Avatar’s weapon strikes the foe with meteoric force.
stratagems.name: Doom Inescapable
stratagems.target: One Avatar of Khaine model from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, select one of the following abilities, or select two of the following abilities if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem: [IGNORES COVER], [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected abilities.
stratagems.flavor: Analysing their targets’ weaknesses with incredible skill, the Aeldari fire for lethal effect.
stratagems.name: Preternatural Precision
stratagems.target: One Aspect Warriors unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: All models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
stratagems.flavor: Embodying the rage of Khaine himself, these warriors press home their attack and strike down those cowards who seek to flee their fury.
stratagems.name: Khaine's Vengeance
stratagems.target: One Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.

enhancements.body:
AELDARI PSYKER model only.
▪ While this model is within 3" of a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit, this model has [core:Lone Operative].
▪ In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly AELDARI VEHICLE model within 3" of this model. That VEHICLE model **[gloss:heal:heals]** D3 wounds.
enhancements.flavor: This spirit stone contains the essence of Bonesinger Raelyth. Those Asuryani psykers who bear this item to battle can draw upon the fallen artisan’s talents.
enhancements.name: Spirit Stone of Raelyth

enhancements.body: AELDARI PSYKER model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit within 6" of this model. That VEHICLE unit's ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.
enhancements.flavor: This seer is closely attuned to their craftworld’s vehicles. Communicating with the souls inhabiting hull-mounted spirit stones can sharpen the tactical awareness of spirits and crew.
enhancements.name: Guiding Presence

rule.body: Friendly AELDARI VEHICLE units' ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
rule.flavor: Asuryani vehicle crews are amongst the galaxy's most naturally gifted pilots and gunners. They can coax every last iota of performance from the formidable machines and weapon systems under their control.
rule.name: Skilled Crews

stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 5+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.
stratagems.flavor: The wraithbone superstructure of this vehicle has been interlaced with warding runes, enabling its hull to resist incoming fire.
stratagems.name: Layered Wards
stratagems.target: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit suffers a **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.

stratagems.effect:
Your unit's attacks can re-roll:
▪ One Hit roll.
▪ One Wound roll.
▪ One **[gloss:damage-roll:Damage roll]**.
stratagems.flavor: Spirit stones containing the souls of gifted seers have been embedded into this vehicle’s targeting matrices. The essences within lend guidance even in death.
stratagems.name: Soulsight
stratagems.target: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.

stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
stratagems.flavor: The result of exquisite and ingenious Aeldari engineering, vectored engines enable grav vehicles to evade their enemies while maintaining accurate fire.
stratagems.name: Vectored Engines
stratagems.target: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit makes a Fall Back move.

enhancements.body: TROUPE MASTER model only. This unit can re-roll **[gloss:charge-roll:Charge rolls]**.
enhancements.flavor: Flowing like starlight across the field of battle, this warrior-artiste leads their chorus in a dance whose speed peaks as they surge into the foe.
enhancements.name: A Foot in the Future

enhancements.body: SHADOWSEER model only. This unit has [core:Infiltrators].
enhancements.flavor: Employing their psychic powers of illusion and obfuscation, this Shadowseer can cause their comrades to vanish from the foe’s perceptions.
enhancements.name: Mistweave

rule.body: While a friendly **HARLEQUINS** unit is making a **[gloss:charge-move:Charge move]**, that unit can move through enemy models.
rule.flavor: Trying to fight the Harlequins of the Laughing God is like battling bladed smoke. They flip and bound through the enemy ranks with contemptuous ease, springing across the heads and shoulders of dumbfounded combatants, sprinting across the hulls of war engines, all the while bearing down with murderous intent upon their true intended victims.
rule.name: Acrobatic Onslaught

stratagems.effect: When a model in your unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if your unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.flavor: Though they may be slain, this step of the saedath calls on the players to act out the demise of tragic heroes who take their enemies with them to death.
stratagems.name: Heroes' Fall
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly HARLEQUINS unit.

stratagems.effect: Place your unit in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:Strategic Reserves]**.
stratagems.flavor: Players know when to fade back from the stage of war, ready to strike again when their moment comes.
stratagems.name: Exit the Stage
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** HARLEQUINS unit.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D3+3".
stratagems.flavor: Advancing foes assured of cutting the Harlequins down are often left thwarted with naught but a swirl of holofield shards where their prey once stood.
stratagems.name: Deceptive Feint
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit.

enhancements.body: RANGERS unit only. This unit's ranged attacks do not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:hidden:hidden]**.
enhancements.flavor: Aeldari Rangers rely upon fieldcraft and marksmanship to defeat their foes. They conceal themselves so expertly that even the act of firing upon the enemy does not reveal their precise location.
enhancements.name: Camouflaged Snipers

enhancements.body: RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit only. This unit's ranged attacks that target a CHARACTER unit have +1 AP.
enhancements.flavor: Having trodden the Path of the Outcast for so long that they risk becoming trapped upon it, these snipers have honed their talents until they can pinpoint eye lenses, armour seals and other weaknesses to fell the toughest foes.
enhancements.name: Assassins' Eye

rule.body: When a friendly **RANGERS**/**SHROUD RUNNERS** unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**, enemy units have +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]** until that friendly unit has shot.
rule.flavor: With snipers’ instincts and psychoresponsive gunsights, the Asuryani frontier scouts can pierce almost any barrier to find the hearts of their targets.
rule.name: Far-Reaching Doom

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll if a model in that enemy unit was **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** by those attacks.
stratagems.flavor: Struck by a sudden volley of precision shots when no foe can be pinpointed can shake the resolve of the most stoic warriors.
stratagems.name: Eldritch Suppression
stratagems.target: That RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit has +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.
stratagems.flavor: Once these snipers have found their range to a shrouded foe with marksmen’s instincts and esoteric targeting technology, they swiftly pass this knowledge onto their allies.
stratagems.name: Casting Back the Veil
stratagems.target: That RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.

stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D6".
▪ Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.
stratagems.flavor: The unconstrained nomadism of a craftworld’s outcasts extends to the battlefield, such that few foes can respond before they melt back into hiding to hunt elsewhere.
stratagems.name: Nomads of the Hidden Way
stratagems.target: That RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.

enhancements.body: TROUPE unit only. This unit has [core:Fights First].
enhancements.flavor: These nightmarish masks torment the enemy with a psychoresponsive bombardment laced through the murk generated by the wearers’ holofields. The confusing distortion leaves enemies vulnerable to the blades that suddenly spear from the terrifying gloom.
enhancements.name: Shadowfall Masks

enhancements.body: HARLEQUINS model only. This unit has [core:Scouts 6"].
enhancements.flavor: With breathtakingly subtle yet rapid movements, this master of the opening act leads the Harlequins in a deadly dance that can catch their foes off guard.
enhancements.name: Prelude Performer

rule.body: Friendly **HARLEQUINS** units have [core:Stealth].
rule.flavor: With their holofields attuned to a mistwreathed shadow performance, the Harlequins are insubstantial blurs as they dash through cover to reach their chosen stage.
rule.name: Dance of Distortion

stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].
stratagems.flavor: Amongst the performances of a saedath is the climactic sundering of monstrous foes or the enemy’s hateful barques, acts the Harlequins have long mastered.
stratagems.name: Presaged Rehearsal
stratagems.target: That TROUPE unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TROUPE unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.

stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
stratagems.flavor: With the placement of sentinel nodes and a performance that echoes their guardianship of things lost to other Aeldari, the Harlequins guard well that which is sacred to them.
stratagems.name: Captivating Performance
stratagems.target: One friendly TROUPE unit.
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.

stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:Normal move]** of up to D6".
▪ Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
stratagems.flavor: The mirage launchers carried by a masque’s graceful craft can be triggered to produce haunting simulacra long enough to deceive the foe and allow a crew to manoeuvre away again to their next stage.
stratagems.name: Phantasmal Mirage
stratagems.target: That HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit has shot.

enhancements.body: HARLEQUINS model only (excluding Solitaire models). Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability.
enhancements.flavor: This mystic wraithbone implement allows the bearer to slip onto the stage from the Webway even before the curtain’s rise, beginning their performance in full and furious flow.
enhancements.name: Key of Ghosts

enhancements.body: Troupe Master model only. Add 3 to the Strength and add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.
enhancements.flavor: A cruel weapon more often kept locked away, this ill-omened implement is said to resonate with the Cosmic Serpent’s own dismay at the suffering of its brood during the Fall.
enhancements.name: Weavers' Wail

enhancements.body: Death Jester model only. When using the bearer's Cruel Amusement ability, you can select two of the abilities for its shrieker cannon to gain, instead of one.
enhancements.flavor: This cruel mask is worn when performing the Serpent’s Brood, and lends its wearer a supernatural degree of venom and spite.
enhancements.name: Fanged Leer

enhancements.body: Shadowseer model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three HARLEQUINS units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.
enhancements.flavor: This glittering cloak projects a grand illusion that falls away as its wearer sheds it like a discarded serpent’s hide, revealing a still-more dismaying reality beneath.
enhancements.name: Shedskin Raiment

rule.body:
Weapons equipped by **Harlequins Mounted** and **Harlequins Vehicle** models from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Each time a **Harlequins** unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, that unit's weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
rule.flavor: Playing their roles to perfection, the Harlequins embody the swift-striking fangs and deadly venoms of the Cosmic Serpent's brood, dominating the stage of the battlefield with their swift and vicious performances.
rule.name: Boons of the Brood

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when using your unit's Dance of Death ability, you can select three of the abilities for your unit to gain, instead of one.
stratagems.flavor: Many are the heads of the brood, and many their fangs. As they spring and tumble over their foes, the Harlequins' weapons echo the multiplicity of strikes unleashed by that mythic nest of snakes.
stratagems.name: Fangs of the Brood
stratagems.target: One Troupe unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: After your unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.flavor: Embodying the serpent that strikes with blinding swiftness, this grav-skimmer lunges suddenly into range and unleashes its full fury on the foe.
stratagems.name: Venomous Wrath
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.flavor: Springing between pillars and rubble, bounding forwards as though running on thin air, the Harlequins acrobatically hurl themselves into battle.
stratagems.name: Striking Stride
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move of up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: Inescapable yet impossible to catch, this unit personifies the ever-winding and incorporeal coils of the Skyweavers of myth.
stratagems.name: Weaver’s Coils
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: End of your Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.flavor: Maintaining their blistering pace, these warriors respond to their foes’ steps in the saedath with their own gravity-defying motions.
stratagems.name: Weaving Stride
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.flavor: Like a serpent rearing back to strike at its prey anew, the Harlequins sweep high and appear to quit the field, ready to descend in fury a moment later.
stratagems.name: Skyward Lunge
stratagems.target: One HARLEQUINS VEHICLE or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

enhancements.body: Prince Yriel unit only. Each time you spend a Battle Focus token to enable this unit to perform an Agile Manoeuvre, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Battle Focus token.
enhancements.flavor: Yriel’s speed, both of thought and action, ensures that he remains one step ahead of his opponents at all times.
enhancements.name: Pirate Prince

enhancements.body: Anhrathe unit only. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LANCE] ability.
enhancements.flavor: The key to any raid is the shock of the opening strike. Anhrathe warriors strike at breakneck speed, power swords and boarding hooks finding gaps in enemy armour and inflicting devastating wounds.
enhancements.name: Alacritous Assault

enhancements.body: Anhrathe unit only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 5+] abilities.
enhancements.flavor: In their travels through the void, these Anhrathe warriors have collected a bounty of esoteric ammunition. The most lethal of these munitions are toxic or acidic enough to fell monstrous foes or to burn through armour and servo-motors with frightening rapidity.
enhancements.name: Exotic Munitions

enhancements.body: ANHRATHE INFANTRY unit only. This unit can perform the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre without spending a Battle Focus token to do so. It can do so even if other units have done so in the same phase, and doing so does not prevent other units from performing the same Agile Manoeuvre in the same phase.
enhancements.flavor: Amongst the hauls taken by Aeldari Corsairs are many stimulants and elixirs, the most powerful of which enhance the already impressive grace and agility of the Aeldari physiology.
enhancements.name: Adrenal Infusions

rule.body:
**Aeldari** units in your army are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced. In addition, each time an **Anhrathe**, **Rangers** or **Shroud Runners** unit from your army Advances, you can re-roll the Advance roll.

**Veterans of the Void:** Each time you add an **Anhrathe** unit to your army, it can be given up to one Corsair Enhancement (see below). Each Corsair Enhancement included in your army must be unique. If a unit is given a Corsair Enhancement, you must increase the points cost of that unit by the amount shown (see Munitorum Field Manual). If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.
rule.flavor: These are Yriel’s most elite raiders, skilled in fast-paced raids and used to fighting superior forces using a combination of guile, superior technology, and physical prowess.
rule.name: Yriel's Own

stratagems.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.flavor: Even as battle rages around them, the Eldritch Raiders prioritise the seizing of treasures above the destruction of their foes.
stratagems.name: Raider’s Spoils
stratagems.target: One Anhrathe unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: These are Yriel’s chosen killers, and there is no escape for their prey.
stratagems.name: Ruthless Killers
stratagems.target: One Corsair Voidscarred unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or Fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
stratagems.flavor: Inspired by their prince, who has felt Ynnead’s touch, the Eldritch Raiders laugh in the face of death.
stratagems.name: Yriel's Example
stratagems.target: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the highest Toughness characteristic of models in the target unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.flavor: By accurately targeting weak points in anatomies and superstructures, the Anhrathe can bring down even the most resilient of foes.
stratagems.name: No Prey Too Big
stratagems.target: One Anhrathe, Rangers or Shroud Runners unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) visible to and within 36" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit declares a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
stratagems.flavor: As the foes attempt to close in, Yriel’s cunning outcasts stymie their assault with a dazzling burst of distracting fire.
stratagems.name: Impeding Fire
stratagems.target: One Rangers, Shroud Runners or Starfang unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If that unit is below Starting Strength, return all destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit.
stratagems.flavor: Prince Yriel commands resources beyond the dreams of most Corsair Princes. Depleted bands may fall back from the battlefield to be reinforced and resupplied at a moment’s notice.
stratagems.name: Withdraw and Reinforce
stratagems.target: One Anhrathe unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

enhancements.body: Anhrathe unit only. While an enemy unit is within 3" of this unit, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit (to a minimum of 1).
enhancements.flavor: These infamous raiders are rightly feared, and use their reputation to their advantage with easily identifiable armour and insignia.
enhancements.name: Infamy

enhancements.body: Anhrathe unit only. Models in this unit have the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can use this ability. If it does, remove this unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
enhancements.flavor: This smooth token contains esoteric knowledge of local Webway spurs. When activated by psychic impulse, it projects a mental map of these routes into the minds of the bearer, enabling them to locate hidden gates, bypass their foes, and seize the treasures they seek.
enhancements.name: Webway Pathstone

enhancements.body:
ANHRATHE CHARACTER unit only. At the start of the battle, select one Character model in this unit. That model has the following ability:
▪ **Lord of Deceit (Aura):** Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, you can use this ability. If you do, increase the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.
enhancements.flavor: A master of the lightning assault, this commander appears prescient in their ability to confound the foe.
enhancements.name: Archraider

enhancements.body: ANHRATHE INFANTRY unit only. Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
enhancements.flavor: Seized from an alien tomb, this obsidian artefact seems to absorb light itself, offering the bearer and their unit a degree of protection against even the strongest attacks.
enhancements.name: Voidstone

rule.body:
While an objective marker is under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

**Anhrathe** units from your army have the following ability:
▪ **Void Thieves:** At the end of a phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

**Veterans of the Void:** Each time you add an **Anhrathe** unit to your army, it can be given up to one Corsair Enhancement (see below). Each Corsair Enhancement included in your army must be unique. If a unit is given a Corsair Enhancement, you must increase the points cost of that unit by the amount shown (see Munitorum Field Manual). If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.
rule.flavor: Should the Anhrathe detect valuable plunder, they will go to great lengths to seize it, and fight with shocking ferocity to protect their prize.
rule.name: Relentless Raiders

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit has the Anhrathe keyword, then until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.flavor: In their pursuit of riches, Anhrathe warriors will fight with violent fury to seize their due.
stratagems.name: Pirates' Due
stratagems.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: The Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If it is an Anhrathe unit, also select one enemy unit your unit was within Engagement Range of at the start of the phase, and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.flavor: With a final flurry of gunshots, blade strikes and explosives, these warriors feign retreat before striking again with renewed aggression.
stratagems.name: Lethal Ruse
stratagems.target: That AELDARI unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an AELDARI unit from your army Falls Back.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] and [RAPID FIRE 1] abilities, and until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.
stratagems.flavor: Anhrathe raiders often find common ground with other Aeldari Outcasts, who use the distraction of the Corsair onslaught to ambush unsuspecting foes.
stratagems.name: Outcast Ambush
stratagems.target: One Rangers or Shroud Runners unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: After your unit has resolved all of its shooting attacks, it can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".
stratagems.flavor: Corsair raiders are swift to exploit gaps in the enemy line and advance upon their objectives.
stratagems.name: Into the Breach
stratagems.target: That Anhrathe unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Anhrathe unit from your army destroyed one or more enemy units.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability and your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
stratagems.flavor: Having secured their prize, the Anhrathe melt into the shadows, leaving their foes shooting at shadows.
stratagems.name: Cloak and Shadow
stratagems.target: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker that you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".
